fields.description: A warming pasta bake made with tinned tomatoes and cheese spread.
fields.instructions: 1. Boil pasta until al dente. 2. Fry onions until soft. 3. Add tinned tomatoes and simmer. 4. Mix pasta with sauce, top with cheese spread. 5. Bake at 180C for 15 minutes.

fields.description: Hearty lentil soup with vegetables, perfect for cold days.
fields.instructions: 1. Dice carrots and onions. 2. Sauté in a large pot for 5 minutes. 3. Add lentils, tinned tomatoes, and 1 litre water. 4. Simmer for 30 minutes until lentils are soft. 5. Season and serve.

fields.description: Spicy bean chilli served with rice, made from store cupboard staples.
fields.instructions: 1. Fry diced onions. 2. Add baked beans and tinned tomatoes. 3. Season with chilli powder and cumin. 4. Simmer for 20 minutes. 5. Serve over cooked rice.

fields.description: Quick and easy tuna pasta with sweetcorn.
fields.instructions: 1. Cook pasta according to pack instructions. 2. Drain tuna and sweetcorn. 3. Mix with hot pasta. 4. Season with pepper and serve.

fields.description: Mild chickpea curry with rice, budget-friendly and filling.
fields.instructions: 1. Fry onions until golden. 2. Add curry powder, stir for 1 minute. 3. Add chickpeas and tomatoes. 4. Simmer for 15 minutes. 5. Serve with boiled rice.

fields.description: Classic spaghetti with a rich lentil and tomato sauce.
fields.instructions: 1. Boil lentils until soft. 2. Fry grated carrots. 3. Add tinned tomatoes and cooked lentils. 4. Simmer for 20 minutes. 5. Serve over spaghetti.

fields.description: Warm porridge topped with tinned fruit, a comforting breakfast.
fields.instructions: 1. Put oats and milk in a saucepan. 2. Cook on medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring. 3. Pour into bowls. 4. Top with drained tinned fruit.

fields.description: Filling potato and bean stew, perfect for feeding a family.
fields.instructions: 1. Peel and dice potatoes. 2. Fry onions until soft. 3. Add potatoes, beans, and tomatoes. 4. Add water to cover. 5. Simmer for 35 minutes until potatoes are tender.

fields.description: Simple egg fried rice with vegetables.
fields.instructions: 1. Cook rice and let cool slightly. 2. Scramble eggs in a wok. 3. Add rice and sweetcorn. 4. Stir-fry for 3 minutes. 5. Season with soy sauce if available.

fields.description: Quick noodle soup with tinned vegetables.
fields.instructions: 1. Boil water and cook noodles. 2. Heat soup in a separate pan. 3. Combine noodles and soup. 4. Add sweetcorn and serve hot.

fields.description: Light couscous salad with chickpeas and tinned vegetables.
fields.instructions: 1. Pour boiling water over couscous and cover for 5 minutes. 2. Fluff with a fork. 3. Drain chickpeas and sweetcorn. 4. Mix everything together. 5. Season and serve.

fields.description: Creamy banana porridge, a nutritious start to the day.
fields.instructions: 1. Put oats and milk in a pan. 2. Cook on medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring. 3. Slice bananas. 4. Pour porridge into bowls and top with banana slices.
